scripts.dev: pnpm build && wrangler dev --config dist/toki/wrangler.json --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to .wrangler/state --var LOCAL_STUB_MODE:enabled --var LOCAL_AUTH_BYPASS:enabled
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:verify:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS records FROM time_sessions"
scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config dist/toki/wrangler.json --outdir .tmp/build-dry-run
scripts.check: pnpm boundaries && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm cf:typecheck && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm db:migrate:local && pnpm db:verify:local && pnpm build && pnpm release:local && pnpm e2e && pnpm e2e:migration && pnpm run audit
